subject: Trump and Netanyahu in a sinking boat, holding on to each other
alt: Carlos Latuff's cartoon: a blue sky with white clouds above a deep blue sea. In the middle a white boat sits tilted in the water and is sinking; blue water bursts up like a fountain on both sides. Two men sit in the boat, holding each other in an embrace: on the left Donald Trump, blond hair, dark suit and red tie; on the right Benjamin Netanyahu, grey hair, dark suit and dark tie. Both are wide-eyed with fear, and sweat drops and motion lines fly around their heads. Bottom left, the cartoonist's signature: LATUFF 2026, MONDOWEISS.
chutki: A white boat is sinking in the middle of the sea. Trump and Netanyahu sit in it clutching each other — Trump on the left, Netanyahu on the right — both wide-eyed, sweat flying around their heads. Water is bursting in over both sides of the boat, so it is already filling from within. Carlos Latuff's signature is at the bottom left: LATUFF 2026, MONDOWEISS.

Latuff's point is blunt: the two leaders who claimed to be each other's support now hold on to each other in the same sinking boat, and that support is not carrying either of them to shore. The embrace here is not consolation but a shared scene of drowning — the same weather, the same water and the same end for both.
